description: This file implements functions for decrypting media buffers and transforming capabilities within an OpenCDM (Open Content Decryption Module) context, including session management and buffer handling, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_ex
methods.description: Performs decryption of a media buffer with protection metadata, handling null session and logging errors.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt
methods.description: Wrapper around the extended decrypt function, simplifying call with default parameters.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_buffer
methods.description: Decrypts a buffer using a session, adding protection metadata, with conditional compilation.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_transform_caps
methods.description: Transforms or processes GstCaps, currently a no-op returning success.
